{"CommandLine":"python3 -c "
import pty, os, time

master, slave = pty.openpty()
pid = os.fork()
if pid == 0:
    os.close(master)
    os.dup2(slave, 0)
    os.dup2(slave, 1)
    os.dup2(slave, 2)
    os.close(slave)
    os.execvp('gh', ['gh', 'auth', 'login', '-h', 'github.com', '-p', 'https', '-w'])
else:
    os.close(slave)
    time.sleep(1)
    # read output
    out = os.read(master, 1024).decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
    print('Initial prompt:', out)
    if 'Authenticate Git' in out or '?' in out:
        os.write(master, b'Y\n')
        time.sleep(1.5)
        out2 = os.read(master, 2048).decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
        print('After Y:', out2)
    os.kill(pid, 9)
